scope: Established block CG native cost control; fixed width2 and fixed power factors, no new algorithm or research success claim

protocol.process_isolation: fresh forked child per timed solve
protocol.timing: kernel construction, random sketch, power setup and solve included; reading frozen dataset excluded
protocol.paired_factor: same seed and rank construction per scalar/block method; native arithmetic may differ from dense GEMM rounding
protocol.memory_matching: scalar same rank32, largest rank fitting corrected persistent-array budget, and largest rank fitting corrected live-array budget
protocol.setup_memory: separate conservative factorization ndarray bound; no hidden dense K or second solve factor
protocol.incomplete_policy: save every completed isolated run; do not infer paired timing for incomplete repeats

validations.source_scope: Chen et al. Section 3.2 distinguishes full reorthogonalization from memory-limited short recurrences; the latter is independently validated here.
